newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch 2007 bond raises final total of NLG 5.0 bln.
newsitem.headline: Dutch 2007 bond raises final total of NLG 5.0 bln.

text.p: The Finance Ministry said this week's tap sales of the Dutch government's 5.75 percent bond due February 2007 had raised a final total of 5.0 billion guilders.
Tap sales opened on Tuesday morning and ran for three days. The average price was 99.49 and the average yield 5.82 percent.
A first tranche of the same bond raised 7.5 billion guilders earlier this year.
